_meta.name: Halloween Storms 2003
_meta.notes: Series of 17 major flares including X17.2 and X10. First time NASA satellites captured full CME-to-impact sequence. Caused satellite anomalies, airline rerouting, power grid stress in Sweden.
_meta.impact: Rerouted polar flights, damaged satellite instruments, caused blackout in Malmö Sweden, GPS errors up to 50m
